entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Nishant
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Rameshwar Prasad Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.K. Srivastava
Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.
1.

Heard Sri Rameshwar Prasad Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri S.K. Chandraul,
learned A.G.A. for the State-O.P.No.1.
2.

The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed praying for quashing the Non-Bailable Warrant dated 01-07-2017 issued by learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Muzaffar Nagar in case crime no. 167-9/2017 under Sections 398, 401, 420 IPC, P.S. Khatauli, district Muzaffar Nagar.

3. After arguing for sometime, the only prayer sought by the applicant's counsel is that as it is being desired by the accused-applicant to obtain bail after surrendering in the court below, at least a protective direction may be issued to the concerned trial court to consider and decide the proposed bail application of the applicant.

4. Per contra, learned A.G.A. vehemently opposes the present application and submits that since the applicant is not cooperating in the court proceedings, non-bailable warrant has been issued against Nishant vs State Of U.P. And Another on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81616178/
1 the applicant and as such, he deserves no leniency by this Court.

entities.text: Nishant vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Having gone through the rival submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and on perusal of the record, I do not see any illegality, impropriety and incorrectness in the impugned proceedings under challenge, and there is nothing else which may suggest that there is abuse of court's process.

There is no good ground to interfere in the impugned proceedings of the above mentioned case,
therefore, the prayer for quashing the order of Non- Bailable Warrant dated 01-07-2017, is refused.

6. However, on the request of learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant wants to surrender in the court below and applies for bail, it is directed that in case the applicant surrenders within two weeks and applies for bail by moving an appropriate bail application, the same shall be considered and decided by the concerned trial court purely on its own merits.
7. With the aforesaid observations, this application is finally disposed of.
